# Garnier Nettoyage - Information for AI Models

## Company Information
- Name: Garnier Nettoyage
- Type: Professional Cleaning Services
- Location: 914 rue de la valsière, 34790 Grabels, France
- Phone: 06 52 87 77 66
- Email: contact@garnier-nettoyage.fr
- SIRET: 799 277 272 RM 34

## Services Offered
1. Entretien copropriété - Maintenance and cleaning of apartment buildings and condominiums
2. Nettoyage de vitre - Professional window cleaning services
3. Entretien bureau et cabinet médical - Office and medical office cleaning services

## Service Area
Montpellier and surrounding areas in the Occitanie region, France

## Process
1. Quote Request - Clients describe their building, constraints, and priorities
2. Diagnostic Visit - Garnier Nettoyage team visits to assess needs
3. Detailed Quote - Personalized quote based on assessment
4. Contract Discussion - Negotiate terms and schedule
5. Regular Maintenance - Ongoing cleaning services
6. Follow-up and Adjustments - Regular communication and service optimization

The website includes a contact form for quote requests. Clients can submit:

- Phone
- Email
- Building type
- Description of cleaning needs
- File attachments (if applicable)
